steps.content: With Lemma out of the picture, Summer's game is also over. She reaches for another piece of cake to replenish her drained mental reserves, chewing absently as she scrutinizes the Director—now shed of her disguise—and searches her memory.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Munch munch... So this is Isomer? Huh. I kind of like her.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Turns out she's into cosplay and dress-up too.
Lemma shoots Summer a glare. The other three children's gazes dance between Lemma and Isomer, uncertain as to what they should do.
Isomer, on the other hand, looks completely at ease.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Thank you all for coming, scientists. To show our appreciation for your guidance today, I've prepared a few gifts on behalf of the symposium organizers.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Summer's visit was rather unexpected, so I had to arrange a rush order. If it's not quite to your taste... I do hope you'll forgive me.
She steps gracefully off the stage as she talks. A handful of gift boxes have somehow appeared on a table nearby. She plucks out the most garish one, shakes it, and Summer's eyes light up instantly.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: G*nd*m?!

The genius high school girl throws herself forward. What she sees makes her gasp—it's a limited edition, no less! Beside herself with joy, she cradles the box, smothering it with kisses while bouncing in place. She races out the door, dying to crack it open and lose herself in tinkering.
Isomer sees her off with a smile. Then her eyes shift, and the remaining children go visibly rigid.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: And as for everyone from the Observation Hub, I recall hearing phrases like "rare collectible," "highly confidential," and "not for public release"... Were you referring to this?

Isomer turns and lifts the black box. In a blur of motion, Enya lunges forward and snatches it away, hugging it to her chest. She then turns around with a composed air, clears her throat, and straightens her expression.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Ahem! Right. Director Isomer, Lemma, and the Chief here seem to have matters to discuss in private. We shouldn't get in the way. Everyone, with me!
The Director sends the children on their way, simply watching them go. Then, almost casually, she appears at your side.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: When Summer first came to the Ring Research Institute, she was appointed Chief Scientist immediately. At the time, I was just an ordinary researcher at a Black Ring observation station. Different field, nothing to show for myself either. I doubt a rising genius like her ever even registered my existence back then.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: But fate has a way of playing tricks. After the Ring Weapon technology was leaked, suspicion spread everywhere. Her identity as a Sinner was dragged back into the spotlight. She came under relentless attack from within the Institute, and in the end, they pinned every charge on her. She was forced to cut ties and fled, branded a deserter.
She lowers her gaze, a touch of sadness in her expression.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: The years after that must have been brutal. I heard she couldn't even go home. It's truly fortunate that the MBCC found her and cleared her name. The way you two work together is really something to see.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: That genius girl who once walked alone has finally found companions she can truly trust. I'm so glad she's found a place to belong by your side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're making it sound way more dramatic than it is. We're just buddies making an anime together. It's not that deep.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: If only Lemma could learn to trust grown-ups as well. She's an exceptional genius. She climbed to this position through sheer effort and now carries the entire Observation Hub on her shoulders—all without any Sinner powers to enhance her mind.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: She's the one who took over as Chief Scientist after Summer left. A "mortal genius" capable of going head-to-head with that "legendary monster."
She smiles at Lemma as she speaks. The "compliment," however, lands coldly.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: So that's what it was. Even if security slipped up, we still have people monitoring the symposium, watching the surveillance feeds. You let them in on purpose.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: The MBCC are also experts in Mania combat. They have exactly the kind of frontline experience we lack. Various circumstances made cooperation difficult before, but I've finally found the "right moment." Why wouldn't I seize it?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Tch. We don't need them.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Do you truly think so?
The smile slips from Isomer's face.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Then I suppose you'll be troubleshooting the 64PA8 through 64PC7 and the entire 8X38 series obstacles on your own? How many more rounds of closed testing will you need? And the cost projections?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I've already covered for you twice on the scheduled EDGE reports. How long of an extension are you asking for this time? Will you be explaining it to them yourself?
Lemma's silence brings the smile back to the Director's face.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: There we go. Now then, let's set up a simple testing environment. I brought the data with me, conveniently enough.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Chief, I'd like to ask you for a favor. Please take a look at this <color=#fb9259>anomaly data reconstruction</color>. The incident occurred within the BR-003 field, and its nature... is somewhat unique.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I know you've dealt with Black Rings extensively. You understand them. So, I'd like to hear your perspective. And if you're willing, you're more than welcome to take our systems for a spin and see where they break.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Wait! That's internal data, classified material! Not even MBCC has clearance—

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: You said it yourself, didn't you? The shackles generate sporadic, chaotic Mania states that can't be reproduced, which are remarkably close to <color=#fb9259>them</color>. Perfect, then. Use them as a trigger and simulate the enemy's attacks more accurately. You know exactly where you're stuck.
Her tone shifts slightly.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: And... "Research should never be compromised by politics." "Technology that can't prove itself stable on a real battlefield isn't worthy of trust." Your words, Lemma.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Tch.
Their exchange carries so much unspoken weight that it's taking your entire focus to keep up. It's not until the Director's eyes land on you that you realize she'd just asked you a question.
No matter how you look at it, this is an opening. You have to take it and play it by ear.
The answer clearly pleases her.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Thank you. It's a genuine pleasure working with you, Chief. I'll be counting on you, then.
She turns off the lights. The cube hovering above her palm begins to flicker, then, thread-like tendrils unfurl, sweeping rapidly across the entire room. And with that, the darkness shifts in hue.

It becomes a deranged space, endlessly dividing and folding in on itself, a prison woven from light where recognition falters and comprehension breaks down. But what is truly being disrupted? The space itself, or your consciousness trying to make sense of it? You can't tell.

Whatever the case, there is one thing that's not beyond you—the several nodes hanging suspended in the void. Their signature is unmistakably EDGE's design. Faint blue light wreathes each one, working in concert to hold this churning chaos together.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: A reconstruction of an incident scene. I scanned and preserved every piece of data from that moment. I've been running simulations against it ever since to verify my findings.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: You've been digging into BR-003 all this time, haven't you? Well, this is just the tip of the iceberg.
The image breaks into static as she speaks. The disturbance leaves a patch of absolute black that crawls toward the nodes. Then, alarms blare to life.
